The 1.34 MarkTarget scalar and the repeated PLD Float32 fields remain unnamed semantically and have no established units; none is proven selected or composed at runtime. They do not support a comparison with Tracer Dart's unnamed 11.0.
unresolved: No selected consumer or runtime path establishes that any stored Float32 is applied as a PLD lock or spotting magnitude, range or duration.
The direct MarkTarget_V2 import contains Field_e2280e0b Float32 1.34 at raw offset 176; its role and units are unnamed and unresolved.
The five root captures contain 52 other raw-verified Float32 fields. Their field hashes, values, roles and units are recorded; no field meaning was transferred from numeric similarity.

The L144 Tracer Dart Affector_LockingSignatureMultiplier_TracerDart has unnamed Field_c9f67ae7 Float32 11.0. It is not comparable to the PLD Field_e2280e0b value or the repeated 75.0/-1.0/-1.0 tuples without semantic and unit evidence.

PLD_Ability is marked decoded-provisional by the coverage DB. Its raw local class key resolves to descriptor Class_e515b7b8 (size 544), and the 16 decoded Float32 candidates were independently raw-checked; semantic names remain unavailable.
Runtime activation and composition remain unproven for the source links and operands.
siteImpact: The known-answer control reproduces the m433 site Float32 encoding only. Analyzer data/sim/ui has no gadget comparison path. No PLD or tracer-dart comparison number is supported because the direct Float32 field roles and units remain unresolved.
